# Psalm 127 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-song of-the-ascents. Of-Solomon. If YHWH not builds the-house, in-vain labor its-builders in-it; if YHWH not guards the-city, in-vain watches the-watchman.

**2** Vain for-you rising-early, sitting-late, eating bread-of toil; so he-gives to-his-beloved sleep.

**3** Behold an-inheritance-of YHWH children; a-reward the-fruit-of the-womb.

**4** Like-arrows in-hand-of a-warrior, so the-sons-of youth.

**5** Blessed the-man who has-filled his-quiver with-them; not they-will-be-ashamed when-they-speak with enemies in-the-gate.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **127:1**: Double 'in-vain' (shav') — the psalm's thesis: all human effort without YHWH is futile. Building and guarding represent constructive and protective labor.

- **127:2**: 'He-gives to-his-beloved sleep' — divine provision comes through rest, not anxious overwork.

— EMET
